sources.title: ScenA: Reference-Driven Multi-Speaker Audio Scene Generation
sources.snippet: ScenA: Reference-Driven Multi-Speaker Audio Scene Generation from In-the-Wild Priors. A text-to-audio flow-matching model that binds multiple reference voices to a free-form scene description.

sources.title: awesome-ai-voice/models/scena.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: The training tackles a specifically identified "Reference Shortcut" failure mode — under standard noise schedules the model can identify the matching reference by noisy-target acoustic similarity, bypassing the text prompt — by using a high-noise-biased timestep distribution that forces reliance on the prompt for speaker assignment.

sources.title: GitHub - finmickey/scena: Project page for ScenA: Reference-Driven ...
sources.snippet: ScenA generates multi-speaker audio scenes — dialogue and conversation with sound effects and ambience — from a text prompt, conditioned on one or more reference-audio clips that set the speakers' voices. It is an audio-only, reference-conditioned text-to-audio flow-matching DiT built on the LTX-2 architecture (~4B parameters). 📄 Paper · 🌐 Project page & samples · 🤗 Model
